bioconda.name: genairr
bioconda.summary: Simulation of adaptive immune receptor sequences with ground-truth annotations
bioconda.description:
GenAIRR simulates immunoglobulin and T-cell receptor rearrangements and writes them as
AIRR records, with the generating alleles, trimming, N regions and somatic hypermutations
recorded per base. Reference data for human, mouse, rat, rabbit and rhesus IG and TR loci
ships with the package, and the simulation kernel is a Rust extension module.

commands: python -c "import GenAIRR.data as d; assert type(d.HUMAN_IGH_OGRDB).__name__ == 'DataConfig'"
python -c "import GenAIRR as ga; r = ga.Experiment.on('human_igh').recombine().run_records(n=5, seed=42); assert len(r) == 5 and r[0]['locus'] == 'IGH'"
